full_prompt_en: The image is a square comic-style illustration of four young band members shown side by side in narrow colored panels. Vertical black dividers split the composition into four strips of similar width, each holding a close bust or half-body view. The first strip at left is vivid red: a blond young man in a teal jacket faces forward with furrowed dark eyebrows, while a dark instrument neck and his hand enter from the lower edge. The second strip has a strong cyan background. An orange-haired youth with spiky hair wears a red top, stares directly ahead with round wide eyes, and holds another dark guitar-like neck diagonally from the lower left. In the third red strip, a dark-haired young person wears a reddish cap with large goggles resting on it, a dark teal jacket, and a patterned white shirt. Their small mouth is set in a serious expression. The last strip is golden yellow and contains a blue-haired young woman in a striped orange and yellow top, looking toward the left with another dark instrument partly visible along the lower right. Heads are large and bodies are cropped tightly, so eyebrows, eyes, and hair silhouettes drive the rhythm. Black ink contours, short hatched shadows, and small rough marks add energy to broad flat color areas. Warm orange and red skin tones are pushed into simplified facets, while cyan and navy shadows give depth beneath the hair and along clothing folds. There is no continuous room behind the figures; the changing background colors keep each silhouette distinct. The light is graphic and even, with bright face planes and dark undercut areas rather than natural cast shadows. The overall composition feels like a lively cast lineup, tied together by repeated direct gazes, sharply divided color blocks, and hand-drawn texture.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形漫画式插画：四位年轻乐队成员并排出现在窄窄的彩色分栏中。竖直黑分隔线把构图切成宽度相近的四条，每条装一位近胸像或半身人物。最左栏是鲜红色：一位金发年轻男子穿青绿色外套，紧皱深眉，朝前看；一段暗色乐器琴颈和他的手从下画边进入。第二栏背景是强烈的青蓝色。一位橙色蓬发的年轻人穿红上衣，用圆而睁大的眼睛直视前方，并握着从左下方斜升的另一段暗色吉他形琴颈。第三条红色栏中，一位深发年轻人戴红褐帽，帽上搁着大护目镜，穿深青绿外套与有花纹的白衬衣。小小的嘴抿成严肃表情。最后一栏为金黄色，一位蓝发年轻女子穿橙黄横条纹上衣，向左看；另一件暗色乐器在右下边部分可见。头部大、身体裁得紧，因此眉眼与头发剪影主导节奏。黑墨轮廓、短排线阴影与细小粗糙痕迹给大片平涂色区增加动势。暖橙与红色肤色被分成简洁切面，青蓝和藏蓝阴影在头发下及衣服褶处给出纵深。人物背后没有连续房间；变化的背景色让每个剪影都清楚分开。光是图形化而均匀的，以面部亮面和下方暗切口表现，而非自然投影。整体构图像活泼的角色列队，由重复的直视目光、明确分割的色块和手绘纹理连在一起。
style_prompt_en: Energetic comic illustration divides a square into narrow vertical color fields with bold dark separators. Saturated vermilion, cyan, and golden yellow alternate behind closely cropped focal forms, creating rapid color changes without spatial background detail. Thick ink contours, angular shadow patches, and small dry-brush hatching keep broad flat areas lively. Warm light planes are broken into simple facets, while navy and teal recesses create compact volume. Repeated large rounded highlights and sharp slanted accents set a brisk graphic rhythm. The surface is slightly rough and printed-looking rather than perfectly smooth. Tight framing and adjacent contrasting hues make each strip distinct while preserving a unified, high-energy arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 充满劲力的漫画插画以粗暗分隔线把方形切成窄窄的竖向色场。饱和朱红、青蓝与金黄在贴近裁切的焦点形体后交替，让颜色迅速转换，而无需空间背景细节。粗墨轮廓、棱角阴影块和细小干笔排线使大片平涂区域保持活跃。暖色受光面拆成简洁切面，藏蓝与青绿凹暗处形成紧凑体积。重复的大圆亮区与尖斜点缀建立轻快的图形节奏。表面略粗糙，带印刷感，而非完美光滑。紧密裁幅与相邻对比色让每一条色栏各自明确，同时维持统一而高能量的布局。
theme_en: Four young band members shown in narrow colored panels
theme_zh: 四位年轻乐队成员出现在窄窄的彩色分栏中
name: Scott Pilgrim
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
